# Bluent

Bluent is a Blazor UI component library. This file is the maintained machine-readable entry point for documentation and coding agents.

## Start here

- [Project README](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/README.md): concise product overview, packages, installation, and project links
- [Bluent consumer skill](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/.agents/skills/bluent/SKILL.md): compact Bluent-first router for coding agents; routes UI intent to canonical docs and targeted references
- [Consumer skill component index](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/.agents/skills/bluent/COMPONENT-INDEX.md): retrieval map across tracked UI, Charts, Diagrams, and Utilities families, with missing canonical coverage called out explicitly
- [Consumer skill decision guide](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/.agents/skills/bluent/DECISION-GUIDE.md): problem-to-component routing without duplicating full APIs
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/getting-started/index.md): canonical installation, registration, styles, containers, and troubleshooting
- [Package selection](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/packages/index.md): package roles, dependency boundaries, namespaces, and optional setup
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/README.md): canonical documentation map and source-of-truth rules
- [Component inventory](https://github.com/vrassouli/Bluent/blob/Dev/docs/components/inventory.md): maintained public-family coverage ledger

## Canonical component references

Source/runtime-verified references currently include Badge, Button, ButtonGroup, Checkbox, DateField, Dialog, DropdownSelect, FileSelect, MaskedField, NumericField, OtpField, RadioGroup/Radio, RangeSlider, SelectField, Slider, Switch, TextField, and TimeField. Use the inventory for exact verification status and do not infer undocumented families from this summary.
